about.title: About Brandon Ling-xuan Chen
about.intro: Research Assistant at the Intelligent Positioning and Navigation Laboratory and IB student at Island School.
paragraphs: I study positioning, navigation and timing at the Intelligent Positioning and Navigation Laboratory, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, where I work as a Research Assistant under Professor Li-Ta Hsu.

My interests include urban GNSS, 3D mapping aided positioning, smartphone and wearable GNSS, and low Earth orbit navigation. I am also completing the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme at Island School in Hong Kong.
